interface: io.github.open-embedded-probe.bench.rs485 rev 1 (ESP-IDF v5.5.5 UART driver, UART4)

driver.rts_polarity: not set by the program (the driver's default); read the active level off the line
driver.de_lead: the driver sets RTS in uart_enable_tx_write_fifo, as it writes the bytes into the FIFO
driver.de_tail: no bit count from the driver: its TX_DONE interrupt handler (transmitter idle) puts RTS back, so the tail is that interrupt's latency (esp_driver_uart/src/uart.c, v5.5)
